What is Dandruff—and Why Won’t It Go Away?

Dandruff Is More Than Just Dry Skin—It’s Often a Scalp Condition

Understanding the root cause is the first step to clearing dandruff permanently.
Dandruff can be caused by excess oil, dryness, fungal infections, or skin conditions like seborrheic dermatitis or scalp psoriasis. Using random shampoos may give temporary relief—but unless we treat the root cause, it keeps coming back.
